``` {r loading_configuration}
pattern <- paste0(drop_list, collapse = "|")

Platform_Events$PLATFORMEVENTS <- gsub(pattern, "", Platform_Events$PLATFORMEVENTS)

Platform_Events <- Platform_Events %>%
  mutate(PLATFORMEVENTS = map_chr(str_split(PLATFORMEVENTS, ","), ~ paste(unique(str_trim(.x)), collapse = ",")))

Platform_Events <- Platform_Events %>%
  separate_longer_delim(PLATFORMEVENTS, delim = ",") %>%
  mutate(PLATFORMEVENTS = trimws(PLATFORMEVENTS), present = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = PLATFORMEVENTS,
    values_from = present,
    values_fill = 0,
    values_fn = max # Ensures a 1 is kept if a word accidentally repeats in a cell
  )

Comp_DF <- merge(Platform_Events, Daily_Checks, by = c('USERID', 'EVENTDATE'), all.x = TRUE)

Comp_DF <- merge(Comp_DF, Monthly_Assessments, by = c('USERID', 'EVENTDATE'), all.x = TRUE)

Comp_DF <- Comp_DF[,-c(35,36,39)]

Comp_DF$EVENTDATE <- as.Date(Comp_DF$EVENTDATE)
```

# Case Counts

``` {r monthly_case_counts}

abc <- Monthly_Risk_Transition %>%
  mutate(EVENTDATE = as.Date(EVENTDATE)) %>%
  group_by(USERID) %>%
  mutate(
    .baseline_date = min(EVENTDATE, na.rm = TRUE),

    .start_window = !is.na(.baseline_date) &
      EVENTDATE >= .baseline_date %m+% months(5) &
      EVENTDATE <= .baseline_date %m+% months(7),

    .start_date = suppressWarnings(min(
      EVENTDATE[.start_window & !is.na(PERIOD_RISK) & PERIOD_RISK == 1],
      na.rm = TRUE
    )),
    .start_date = as.Date(ifelse(is.infinite(.start_date), NA, .start_date), origin = "1970-01-01"),

    START_RISK = as.integer(!is.na(.start_date) & PERIOD_RISK == 1 & EVENTDATE == .start_date)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. build_end_risk(): computes END_RISK for an arbitrary follow-up
#    window of `target_months` after START_RISK.
#    window = [target_months - 1, target_months + 1], tie-break at
#    exactly `target_months`.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
build_end_risk <- function(data, target_months) {
  data <- data %>%
    group_by(USERID) %>%
    mutate(
      .in_window = !is.na(.start_date) &
        EVENTDATE >= .start_date %m+% months(target_months - 1) &
        EVENTDATE <= .start_date %m+% months(target_months + 1),

      .end1_date = suppressWarnings(min(
        EVENTDATE[.in_window & PERIOD_RISK == 1 & !is.na(MONTHLY) & MONTHLY == 1],
        na.rm = TRUE
      )),
      .end1_date = as.Date(ifelse(is.infinite(.end1_date), NA, .end1_date), origin = "1970-01-01")
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  period_clean <- data %>%
    filter(.in_window) %>%
    group_by(USERID, PERIOD) %>%
    summarise(.period_all_zero = all(!is.na(PERIOD_RISK) & PERIOD_RISK == 0), .groups = "drop")

  data <- data %>% left_join(period_clean, by = c("USERID", "PERIOD"))

  max_clean_period <- data %>%
    filter(.in_window, .period_all_zero) %>%
    group_by(USERID) %>%
    summarise(.max_period0 = max(PERIOD), .groups = "drop")

  data %>%
    left_join(max_clean_period, by = "USERID") %>%
    group_by(USERID) %>%
    mutate(
      .end0_date = suppressWarnings(min(
        EVENTDATE[.in_window & !is.na(.max_period0) & PERIOD == .max_period0 &
                    !is.na(MONTHLY) & MONTHLY == 1],
        na.rm = TRUE
      )),
      .end0_date = as.Date(ifelse(is.infinite(.end0_date), NA, .end0_date), origin = "1970-01-01"),

      # tie-break: keep whichever candidate is closest to `target_months`
      .target_mark = .start_date %m+% months(target_months),
      .dist1 = abs(as.numeric(.end1_date - .target_mark)),
      .dist0 = abs(as.numeric(.end0_date - .target_mark)),
      .keep1 = !is.na(.end1_date) & (is.na(.end0_date) | .dist1 <= .dist0),
      .keep0 = !is.na(.end0_date) & (is.na(.end1_date) | .dist0 <  .dist1),

      END_RISK = case_when(
        .keep1 & PERIOD_RISK == 1 & !is.na(MONTHLY) & MONTHLY == 1 & EVENTDATE == .end1_date ~ 1L,
        .keep0 & PERIOD_RISK == 0 & !is.na(MONTHLY) & MONTHLY == 1 & EVENTDATE == .end0_date ~ 0L,
        TRUE ~ NA_integer_
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(-starts_with("."))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. build_outcome_table(): from a data frame that already has
#    START_RISK + END_RISK for one follow-up window, produces one row
#    per USERID with START_RISK, END_RISK_<suffix>,
#    SUM_JOURNEY_USE_M_<suffix>, and each of `score_cols` measured AT
#    the END_RISK marker's EVENTDATE (named "<col>_AT_END_RISK_<suffix>")
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
build_outcome_table <- function(data_with_end_risk, monthly_df, suffix, score_cols) {

  risk_subset <- data_with_end_risk %>%
    group_by(USERID) %>%
    filter(any(START_RISK == 1, na.rm = TRUE) & any(!is.na(END_RISK))) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(USERID, PERIOD, EVENTDATE) %>%
    group_by(USERID, PERIOD) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(START_RISK == 1 | !is.na(END_RISK)) %>%
    distinct(USERID, EVENTDATE, .keep_all = TRUE)

  sum_journey <- risk_subset %>%
    transmute(USERID, EVENTDATE, EVENTDATE_COPY = EVENTDATE) %>%
    full_join(monthly_df[, c("USERID", "EVENTDATE", "TOTAL_JOURNEY_USE_M")],
              by = c("USERID", "EVENTDATE")) %>%
    mutate(EVENTDATE = as.Date(EVENTDATE), EVENTDATE_COPY = as.Date(EVENTDATE_COPY)) %>%
    arrange(USERID, EVENTDATE) %>%
    group_by(USERID) %>%
    mutate(
      .rn         = row_number(),
      .first_pop  = suppressWarnings(min(.rn[!is.na(EVENTDATE_COPY)])),
      .first_pop  = ifelse(is.infinite(.first_pop), NA_integer_, .first_pop),
      .second_pop = {
        pos <- sort(.rn[!is.na(EVENTDATE_COPY)])
        if (length(pos) >= 2) pos[2] else NA_integer_
      },
      .end_row    = ifelse(!is.na(.second_pop), .second_pop - 1L, max(.rn)),
      SUM_JOURNEY_USE_M = ifelse(
        !is.na(.first_pop) & .rn == .first_pop,
        sum(TOTAL_JOURNEY_USE_M[.rn >= .first_pop & .rn <= .end_row], na.rm = TRUE),
        NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(-starts_with("."))

  score_end_names <- paste0(score_cols, "_AT_END_RISK_", suffix)

  out <- risk_subset %>%
    arrange(USERID, EVENTDATE) %>%
    group_by(USERID) %>%
    mutate(
      END_RISK_final = lead(END_RISK),
      # pull each score column's value from the NEXT row (the END_RISK
      # marker row) onto the START_RISK row, same trick as END_RISK
      across(all_of(score_cols), ~ lead(.x), .names = paste0("{.col}_AT_END_RISK_", suffix))
    ) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(USERID, START_RISK, END_RISK_final, all_of(score_end_names)) %>%
    left_join(
      sum_journey %>% filter(!is.na(SUM_JOURNEY_USE_M)) %>% select(USERID, SUM_JOURNEY_USE_M),
      by = "USERID"
    )

  names(out)[names(out) == "END_RISK_final"]   <- paste0("END_RISK_", suffix)
  names(out)[names(out) == "SUM_JOURNEY_USE_M"] <- paste0("SUM_JOURNEY_USE_M_", suffix)

  out
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Build the 1-, 3-, and 6-month outcome tables and combine
#    (12-month outcome pair removed per request)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
score_cols <- c("STRESSLEVEL", "MANAGEFEELINGSLEVEL", "FEELINGSFREQUENCY",
                 "DAYSEMOTIONALLYCHALLENGING", "MANAGESTRESSLEVEL")

outcomes_1 <- build_outcome_table(build_end_risk(abc, 1), Monthly_DF, "1", score_cols)
outcomes_3 <- build_outcome_table(build_end_risk(abc, 3), Monthly_DF, "3", score_cols)
outcomes_6 <- build_outcome_table(build_end_risk(abc, 6), Monthly_DF, "6", score_cols)

# score values AT the START_RISK timepoint (same physical row regardless
# of follow-up window, so computed once here rather than per suffix)
start_scores <- abc %>%
  filter(START_RISK == 1) %>%
  distinct(USERID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(USERID, all_of(score_cols)) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_AT_START_RISK"), all_of(score_cols))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Sums of TOTAL_JOURNEY_USE_M BEFORE START_RISK: 1, 3, and 6 months
#    prior to the START_RISK date (window is [start_date - N months,
#    start_date), i.e. up to but not including the START_RISK row
#    itself).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
start_dates <- abc %>%
  filter(START_RISK == 1) %>%
  distinct(USERID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(USERID, START_RISK_DATE = EVENTDATE)

before_sums <- start_dates %>%
  left_join(Monthly_DF[, c("USERID", "EVENTDATE", "TOTAL_JOURNEY_USE_M")], by = "USERID") %>%
  mutate(EVENTDATE = as.Date(EVENTDATE)) %>%
  group_by(USERID, START_RISK_DATE) %>%
  summarise(
    SUM_JOURNEY_USE_M_BEFORE_1 = sum(
      TOTAL_JOURNEY_USE_M[EVENTDATE >= START_RISK_DATE %m-% months(1) & EVENTDATE < START_RISK_DATE],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    SUM_JOURNEY_USE_M_BEFORE_3 = sum(
      TOTAL_JOURNEY_USE_M[EVENTDATE >= START_RISK_DATE %m-% months(3) & EVENTDATE < START_RISK_DATE],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    SUM_JOURNEY_USE_M_BEFORE_6 = sum(
      TOTAL_JOURNEY_USE_M[EVENTDATE >= START_RISK_DATE %m-% months(6) & EVENTDATE < START_RISK_DATE],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  select(-START_RISK_DATE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Combine everything into one wide table
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
six_month_outcomes <- outcomes_1 %>%
  full_join(outcomes_3 %>% select(-START_RISK), by = "USERID") %>%
  full_join(outcomes_6 %>% select(-START_RISK), by = "USERID") %>%
  full_join(before_sums, by = "USERID") %>%
  full_join(start_scores, by = "USERID") %>%
  select(USERID, START_RISK,
         END_RISK_1, SUM_JOURNEY_USE_M_1,
         END_RISK_3, SUM_JOURNEY_USE_M_3,
         END_RISK_6, SUM_JOURNEY_USE_M_6,
         SUM_JOURNEY_USE_M_BEFORE_1, SUM_JOURNEY_USE_M_BEFORE_3, SUM_JOURNEY_USE_M_BEFORE_6,
         ends_with("_AT_START_RISK"),
         ends_with("_AT_END_RISK_1"),
         ends_with("_AT_END_RISK_3"),
         ends_with("_AT_END_RISK_6"))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. "INCREASE" flags: YES/NO/NA comparisons of each after-timepoint
#    value against its corresponding before/start baseline
#    - JOURNEY_INCREASE_<n>: after (1/3/6 month window sum) vs. before
#      (same-length window prior to START_RISK)
#    - <SCORE>_INCREASE_<n>: value AT the END_RISK_<n> marker vs. value
#      AT the START_RISK row
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
six_month_outcomes <- six_month_outcomes %>%
  mutate(
    JOURNEY_INCREASE_1 = case_when(
      is.na(SUM_JOURNEY_USE_M_1) | is.na(SUM_JOURNEY_USE_M_BEFORE_1) ~ NA_character_,
      SUM_JOURNEY_USE_M_1 > SUM_JOURNEY_USE_M_BEFORE_1                ~ "YES",

    STRESSLEVEL_INCREASE_1 = case_when(

      STRESSLEVEL_AT_END_RISK_1 > STRESSLEVEL_AT_START_RISK                ~ "YES",

    # --- FEELINGSFREQUENCY ---
    FEELINGSFREQUENCY_INCREASE_1 = case_when(

    # --- DAYSEMOTIONALLYCHALLENGING ---
    DAYSEMOTIONALLYCHALLENGING_INCREASE_1 = case_when(
```

``` {r daily_case_counts}

########################################################################
# Add BEFORE / AFTER window columns per USERID
#
# For each USERID, and for each window length N in {1, 3, 6} months:
#
#   BEFORE window = [first EVENTDATE for that USERID,
#                     first EVENTDATE + N months)
#     MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_<N>      = mean(FEELINGRATING) in that window
#     SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_<N>  = sum(Comp_JOURNEY_USE_D) in that window
#
#   AFTER window  = [the EVENTDATE immediately following the LAST
#                     EVENTDATE included in the BEFORE_<N> window,
#                     that same start date + N months)
#     MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_<N>       = mean(FEELINGRATING) in that window
#     SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_<N>   = sum(Comp_JOURNEY_USE_D) in that window
#
# NOTE: the "last EVENTDATE in the BEFORE window" (and therefore the
# start of the AFTER window) is recalculated separately for each window
# length N, since a longer BEFORE window naturally ends later. So the
# AFTER_1 / AFTER_3 / AFTER_6 windows each start on a different date.
#
# All 12 new columns (mean/sum x before/after x 1/3/6 months) are
# broadcast onto EVERY row for that USERID (same value repeated across
# all of that USERID's rows) before being collapsed down to a single
# row per USERID in the final step below.
#
# If a USERID has no EVENTDATE after the BEFORE window closes (i.e. the
# BEFORE window's last date is also their very last observation), the
# AFTER columns for that window length are NA.
########################################################################

# ---- 1. Read in the data -------------------------------------------------
daily_cases <- Monthly_Risk_Transition
daily_cases$EVENTDATE <- as.Date(daily_cases$EVENTDATE, format = "%Y-%m-%d")

# ---- 2. Helper: build BEFORE/AFTER mean + sum columns for one window
#         length (in months), returning one row per USERID with columns
#         suffixed by that window length -------------------------------
build_before_after <- function(data, months_n, suffix) {
  data %>%
    group_by(USERID) %>%
    summarise(
      .baseline_date = min(EVENTDATE, na.rm = TRUE),
      .before_end    = .baseline_date %m+% months(months_n),

      .before_last_date = suppressWarnings(max(
        EVENTDATE[EVENTDATE >= .baseline_date & EVENTDATE < .before_end],
        na.rm = TRUE
      )),
      .before_last_date = as.Date(ifelse(is.infinite(.before_last_date), NA, .before_last_date),
                                   origin = "1970-01-01"),

      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE = mean(
        FEELINGRATING[EVENTDATE >= .baseline_date & EVENTDATE < .before_end],
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE = sum(
        Comp_JOURNEY_USE_D[EVENTDATE >= .baseline_date & EVENTDATE < .before_end],
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

      # AFTER window starts at the next EVENTDATE strictly after the
      # last date included in the BEFORE window
      .after_start = suppressWarnings(min(
        EVENTDATE[!is.na(.before_last_date) & EVENTDATE > .before_last_date],
        na.rm = TRUE
      )),
      .after_start = as.Date(ifelse(is.infinite(.after_start), NA, .after_start),
                              origin = "1970-01-01"),
      .after_end   = .after_start %m+% months(months_n),

      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER = ifelse(
        is.na(.after_start), NA_real_,
        mean(FEELINGRATING[EVENTDATE >= .after_start & EVENTDATE < .after_end], na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER = ifelse(
        is.na(.after_start), NA_real_,
        sum(Comp_JOURNEY_USE_D[EVENTDATE >= .after_start & EVENTDATE < .after_end], na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    select(-starts_with(".")) %>%
    rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_", suffix), -USERID)
}

# ---- 3. Build the 1-, 3-, and 6-month BEFORE/AFTER tables and merge
#         them back onto every row of the original data ----------------
windows_1 <- build_before_after(daily_cases, 1, "1")
windows_3 <- build_before_after(daily_cases, 3, "3")
windows_6 <- build_before_after(daily_cases, 6, "6")

daily_cases <- daily_cases %>%
  left_join(windows_1, by = "USERID") %>%
  left_join(windows_3, by = "USERID") %>%
  left_join(windows_6, by = "USERID")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. MEAN_FEELINGRATING change: raw difference (after - before) and a
#    recoded 3-level version for each window length
#    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_<n>   = MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_<n> - MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_<n>
#    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_CHANGE_<n> = "SAME"     if |diff| <  0.25
#                                     "IMPROVED" if  diff  >  0.25
#                                     "WORSENED" if  diff  <= -0.25
#    NOTE: as specified, a difference of EXACTLY +0.25 falls into none
#    of the three buckets (not < 0.25, not > 0.25, not <= -0.25) and is
#    left as NA below. If you'd rather +0.25 count as "IMPROVED", change
#    the ">" to ">=" in the IMPROVED condition.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
daily_cases <- daily_cases %>%
  mutate(
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1 = MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_1 - MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_1,
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_3 = MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_3 - MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_3,
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_6 = MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_6 - MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_6,

    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_CHANGE_1 = case_when(
      is.na(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1)      ~ NA_character_,
      abs(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1) < 0.25  ~ "SAME",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1 > 0.25       ~ "IMPROVED",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1 <= -0.25     ~ "WORSENED",
      TRUE                                   ~ NA_character_
    ),
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_CHANGE_3 = case_when(
      is.na(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_3)      ~ NA_character_,
      abs(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_3) < 0.25  ~ "SAME",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_3 > 0.25       ~ "IMPROVED",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_3 <= -0.25     ~ "WORSENED",
      TRUE                                   ~ NA_character_
    ),
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_CHANGE_6 = case_when(
      is.na(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_6)      ~ NA_character_,
      abs(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_6) < 0.25  ~ "SAME",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_6 > 0.25       ~ "IMPROVED",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_6 <= -0.25     ~ "WORSENED",
      TRUE                                   ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. JOURNEY_INCREASE flags: does Comp_JOURNEY_USE_D go up from the
#    BEFORE window to the AFTER window, for each window length?
#    Mirrors the SUM_JOURNEY_USE_M_<n> / SUM_JOURNEY_USE_M_BEFORE_<n>
#    pattern, using SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_<n> /
#    SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_<n> instead.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
daily_cases <- daily_cases %>%
  mutate(
    JOURNEY_INCREASE_1 = case_when(
      is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_1) | is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_1) ~ NA_character_,
      SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_1 > SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_1                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                                            ~ "NO"
    ),
    JOURNEY_INCREASE_3 = case_when(
      is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_3) | is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_3) ~ NA_character_,
      SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_3 > SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_3                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                                            ~ "NO"
    ),
    JOURNEY_INCREASE_6 = case_when(
      is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_6) | is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_6) ~ NA_character_,
      SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_6 > SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_6                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                                            ~ "NO"
    )
  )

daily_cases <- daily_cases %>% 
  distinct(USERID, .keep_all = TRUE)

```



``` {r daily_case_counts_low_scores}

########################################################################
# Add BEFORE / AFTER window columns per USERID
# VARIANT: restricted to USERIDs who have EVER reported a FEELINGRATING
# of 1 or 2, with the BEFORE windows starting at the FIRST EVENTDATE at
# which a 1 or 2 value was observed (not simply that USERID's earliest
# EVENTDATE overall).
#
# For each qualifying USERID, and for each window length N in {1,3,6}
# months:
#
#   BASELINE_DATE = first EVENTDATE for that USERID where
#                    FEELINGRATING %in% c(1, 2)
#
#   BEFORE window = [BASELINE_DATE, BASELINE_DATE + N months)
#     MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_<N>      = mean(FEELINGRATING) in that window
#     SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_<N>  = sum(Comp_JOURNEY_USE_D) in that window
#
#   AFTER window  = [the EVENTDATE immediately following the LAST
#                     EVENTDATE included in the BEFORE_<N> window,
#                     that same start date + N months)
#     MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_<N>       = mean(FEELINGRATING) in that window
#     SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_<N>   = sum(Comp_JOURNEY_USE_D) in that window
#
# USERIDs who never reported a FEELINGRATING of 1 or 2 are dropped
# entirely before any of the BEFORE/AFTER calculations run.
########################################################################


# ---- 1. Read in the data, restrict to qualifying USERIDs -----------------
daily_cases_low_feeling <- Comp_DF
daily_cases_low_feeling$EVENTDATE <- as.Date(daily_cases_low_feeling$EVENTDATE, format = "%Y-%m-%d")

qualifying_userids <- daily_cases_low_feeling %>%
  filter(!is.na(FEELINGRATING), FEELINGRATING %in% c(1, 2)) %>%
  distinct(USERID) %>%
  pull(USERID)

daily_cases_low_feeling <- daily_cases_low_feeling %>%
  filter(USERID %in% qualifying_userids)

# ---- 2. Baseline date per USERID: first EVENTDATE where FEELINGRATING
#         is 1 or 2 (this replaces "first EVENTDATE overall" as the
#         BEFORE-window start) --------------------------------------------
baseline_dates <- daily_cases_low_feeling %>%
  filter(!is.na(FEELINGRATING), FEELINGRATING %in% c(1, 2)) %>%
  group_by(USERID) %>%
  summarise(BASELINE_DATE = min(EVENTDATE, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# ---- 3. Helper: build BEFORE/AFTER mean + sum columns for one window
#         length (in months), returning one row per USERID with columns
#         suffixed by that window length. `baseline_dates` supplies the
#         per-USERID BEFORE-window start date. -----------------------
build_before_after <- function(data, baseline_dates, months_n, suffix) {
  data %>%
    left_join(baseline_dates, by = "USERID") %>%
    group_by(USERID) %>%
    summarise(
      .before_end = BASELINE_DATE[1] %m+% months(months_n),

      .before_last_date = suppressWarnings(max(
        EVENTDATE[EVENTDATE >= BASELINE_DATE & EVENTDATE < .before_end],
        na.rm = TRUE
      )),
      .before_last_date = as.Date(ifelse(is.infinite(.before_last_date), NA, .before_last_date),
                                   origin = "1970-01-01"),

      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE = mean(
        FEELINGRATING[EVENTDATE >= BASELINE_DATE & EVENTDATE < .before_end],
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE = sum(
        Comp_JOURNEY_USE_D[EVENTDATE >= BASELINE_DATE & EVENTDATE < .before_end],
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

      # AFTER window starts at the next EVENTDATE strictly after the
      # last date included in the BEFORE window
      .after_start = suppressWarnings(min(
        EVENTDATE[!is.na(.before_last_date) & EVENTDATE > .before_last_date],
        na.rm = TRUE
      )),
      .after_start = as.Date(ifelse(is.infinite(.after_start), NA, .after_start),
                              origin = "1970-01-01"),
      .after_end   = .after_start %m+% months(months_n),

      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER = ifelse(
        is.na(.after_start), NA_real_,
        mean(FEELINGRATING[EVENTDATE >= .after_start & EVENTDATE < .after_end], na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER = ifelse(
        is.na(.after_start), NA_real_,
        sum(Comp_JOURNEY_USE_D[EVENTDATE >= .after_start & EVENTDATE < .after_end], na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    select(-starts_with(".")) %>%
    rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_", suffix), -USERID)
}

# ---- 4. Build the 1-, 3-, and 6-month BEFORE/AFTER tables and merge
#         them back onto every row of the (filtered) data ---------------
windows_1 <- build_before_after(daily_cases_low_feeling, baseline_dates, 1, "1")
windows_3 <- build_before_after(daily_cases_low_feeling, baseline_dates, 3, "3")
windows_6 <- build_before_after(daily_cases_low_feeling, baseline_dates, 6, "6")

daily_cases_low_feeling <- daily_cases_low_feeling %>%
  left_join(windows_1, by = "USERID") %>%
  left_join(windows_3, by = "USERID") %>%
  left_join(windows_6, by = "USERID")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. MEAN_FEELINGRATING change: raw difference (after - before) and a
#    recoded 3-level version for each window length
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
daily_cases_low_feeling <- daily_cases_low_feeling %>%
  mutate(
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1 = MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_1 - MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_1,
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_3 = MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_3 - MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_3,
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_6 = MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_6 - MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_6,

    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_CHANGE_1 = case_when(
      is.na(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1)      ~ NA_character_,
      abs(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1) < 0.25  ~ "SAME",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1 > 0.25       ~ "IMPROVED",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1 <= -0.25     ~ "WORSENED",
      TRUE                                   ~ NA_character_
    ),
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_CHANGE_3 = case_when(
      is.na(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_3)      ~ NA_character_,
      abs(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_3) < 0.25  ~ "SAME",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_3 > 0.25       ~ "IMPROVED",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_3 <= -0.25     ~ "WORSENED",
      TRUE                                   ~ NA_character_
    ),
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_CHANGE_6 = case_when(
      is.na(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_6)      ~ NA_character_,
      abs(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_6) < 0.25  ~ "SAME",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_6 > 0.25       ~ "IMPROVED",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_6 <= -0.25     ~ "WORSENED",
      TRUE                                   ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. JOURNEY_INCREASE flags: does Comp_JOURNEY_USE_D go up from the
#    BEFORE window to the AFTER window, for each window length?
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
daily_cases_low_feeling <- daily_cases_low_feeling %>%
  mutate(
    JOURNEY_INCREASE_1 = case_when(
      is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_1) | is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_1) ~ NA_character_,
      SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_1 > SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_1                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                                            ~ "NO"
    ),
    JOURNEY_INCREASE_3 = case_when(
      is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_3) | is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_3) ~ NA_character_,
      SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_3 > SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_3                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                                            ~ "NO"
    ),
    JOURNEY_INCREASE_6 = case_when(
      is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_6) | is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_6) ~ NA_character_,
      SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_6 > SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_6                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                                            ~ "NO"
    )
  )

daily_cases_low_feeling <- daily_cases_low_feeling %>% 
  distinct(USERID, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

``` {r daily_case_counts_rolling_min}

daily_cases_rolling_min <- Monthly_Risk_Transition

daily_cases_rolling_min$EVENTDATE <- as.Date(daily_cases_rolling_min$EVENTDATE, format = "%Y-%m-%d")

# ---- 2. Baseline date per USERID: the EVENTDATE that starts the 1-month
#         window with the LOWEST mean FEELINGRATING for that USERID -------
baseline_dates <- daily_cases_rolling_min %>%
  arrange(USERID, EVENTDATE) %>%
  group_by(USERID) %>%
  mutate(
    # rolling 1-month mean FEELINGRATING, using each observed EVENTDATE
    # as a candidate window start
    .rolling_mean_1mo = sapply(seq_along(EVENTDATE), function(i) {
      window_end <- EVENTDATE[i] %m+% months(1)
      mean(FEELINGRATING[EVENTDATE >= EVENTDATE[i] & EVENTDATE < window_end], na.rm = TRUE)
    })
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    BASELINE_DATE = {
      valid <- !is.nan(.rolling_mean_1mo) & !is.na(.rolling_mean_1mo)
      if (any(valid)) {
        EVENTDATE[valid][which.min(.rolling_mean_1mo[valid])]
      } else {
        as.Date(NA)
      }
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ---- 3. Helper: build BEFORE/AFTER mean + sum columns for one window
#         length (in months), returning one row per USERID with columns
#         suffixed by that window length. `baseline_dates` supplies the
#         per-USERID BEFORE-window start date. -----------------------
build_before_after <- function(data, baseline_dates, months_n, suffix) {
  data %>%
    left_join(baseline_dates, by = "USERID") %>%
    group_by(USERID) %>%
    summarise(
      .before_end = BASELINE_DATE[1] %m+% months(months_n),

      .before_last_date = suppressWarnings(max(
        EVENTDATE[!is.na(BASELINE_DATE) & EVENTDATE >= BASELINE_DATE & EVENTDATE < .before_end],
        na.rm = TRUE
      )),
      .before_last_date = as.Date(ifelse(is.infinite(.before_last_date), NA, .before_last_date),
                                   origin = "1970-01-01"),

      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE = ifelse(
        is.na(BASELINE_DATE[1]), NA_real_,
        mean(FEELINGRATING[EVENTDATE >= BASELINE_DATE & EVENTDATE < .before_end], na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE = ifelse(
        is.na(BASELINE_DATE[1]), NA_real_,
        sum(Comp_JOURNEY_USE_D[EVENTDATE >= BASELINE_DATE & EVENTDATE < .before_end], na.rm = TRUE)
      ),

      # AFTER window starts at the next EVENTDATE strictly after the
      # last date included in the BEFORE window
      .after_start = suppressWarnings(min(
        EVENTDATE[!is.na(.before_last_date) & EVENTDATE > .before_last_date],
        na.rm = TRUE
      )),
      .after_start = as.Date(ifelse(is.infinite(.after_start), NA, .after_start),
                              origin = "1970-01-01"),
      .after_end   = .after_start %m+% months(months_n),

      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER = ifelse(
        is.na(.after_start), NA_real_,
        mean(FEELINGRATING[EVENTDATE >= .after_start & EVENTDATE < .after_end], na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER = ifelse(
        is.na(.after_start), NA_real_,
        sum(Comp_JOURNEY_USE_D[EVENTDATE >= .after_start & EVENTDATE < .after_end], na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    select(-starts_with(".")) %>%
    rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_", suffix), -USERID)
}

# ---- 4. Build the 1-, 3-, and 6-month BEFORE/AFTER tables and merge
#         them back onto every row of the data ---------------------------
windows_1 <- build_before_after(daily_cases_rolling_min, baseline_dates, 1, "1")
windows_3 <- build_before_after(daily_cases_rolling_min, baseline_dates, 3, "3")
windows_6 <- build_before_after(daily_cases_rolling_min, baseline_dates, 6, "6")

daily_cases_rolling_min <- daily_cases_rolling_min %>%
  left_join(windows_1, by = "USERID") %>%
  left_join(windows_3, by = "USERID") %>%
  left_join(windows_6, by = "USERID")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. MEAN_FEELINGRATING change: raw difference (after - before) and a
#    recoded 3-level version for each window length
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
daily_cases_rolling_min <- daily_cases_rolling_min %>%
  mutate(
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1 = MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_1 - MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_1,
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_3 = MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_3 - MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_3,
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_6 = MEAN_FEELINGRATING_AFTER_6 - MEAN_FEELINGRATING_BEFORE_6,

    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_CHANGE_1 = case_when(
      is.na(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1)      ~ NA_character_,
      abs(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1) < 0.25  ~ "SAME",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1 > 0.25       ~ "IMPROVED",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_1 <= -0.25     ~ "WORSENED",
      TRUE                                   ~ NA_character_
    ),
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_CHANGE_3 = case_when(
      is.na(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_3)      ~ NA_character_,
      abs(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_3) < 0.25  ~ "SAME",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_3 > 0.25       ~ "IMPROVED",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_3 <= -0.25     ~ "WORSENED",
      TRUE                                   ~ NA_character_
    ),
    MEAN_FEELINGRATING_CHANGE_6 = case_when(
      is.na(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_6)      ~ NA_character_,
      abs(MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_6) < 0.25  ~ "SAME",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_6 > 0.25       ~ "IMPROVED",
      MEAN_FEELINGRATING_DIFF_6 <= -0.25     ~ "WORSENED",
      TRUE                                   ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. JOURNEY_INCREASE flags: does Comp_JOURNEY_USE_D go up from the
#    BEFORE window to the AFTER window, for each window length?
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
daily_cases_rolling_min <- daily_cases_rolling_min %>%
  mutate(
    JOURNEY_INCREASE_1 = case_when(
      is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_1) | is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_1) ~ NA_character_,
      SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_1 > SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_1                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                                            ~ "NO"
    ),
    JOURNEY_INCREASE_3 = case_when(
      is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_3) | is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_3) ~ NA_character_,
      SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_3 > SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_3                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                                            ~ "NO"
    ),
    JOURNEY_INCREASE_6 = case_when(
      is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_6) | is.na(SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_6) ~ NA_character_,
      SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_AFTER_6 > SUM_COMP_JOURNEY_USE_D_BEFORE_6                ~ "YES",
      TRUE                                                                            ~ "NO"
    )
  )

daily_cases_rolling_min <- daily_cases_rolling_min %>% 
  distinct(USERID, .keep_all = TRUE)

```

```{r case_count_analyses_monthly}
# every row/column pair to cross-tabulate
crosstab_pairs <- list(
  c("JOURNEY_INCREASE_1", "END_RISK_1"),
  c("JOURNEY_INCREASE_3", "END_RISK_3"),
  c("JOURNEY_INCREASE_6", "END_RISK_6"),
  c("JOURNEY_INCREASE_1", "STRESSLEVEL_INCREASE_1"),
  c("JOURNEY_INCREASE_3", "STRESSLEVEL_INCREASE_3"),
  c("JOURNEY_INCREASE_6", "STRESSLEVEL_INCREASE_6"),
  c("JOURNEY_INCREASE_1", "MANAGEFEELINGSLEVEL_INCREASE_1"),
  c("JOURNEY_INCREASE_3", "MANAGEFEELINGSLEVEL_INCREASE_3"),
  c("JOURNEY_INCREASE_6", "MANAGEFEELINGSLEVEL_INCREASE_6"),
  c("JOURNEY_INCREASE_1", "FEELINGSFREQUENCY_INCREASE_1"),
  c("JOURNEY_INCREASE_3", "FEELINGSFREQUENCY_INCREASE_3"),
  c("JOURNEY_INCREASE_6", "FEELINGSFREQUENCY_INCREASE_6"),
  c("JOURNEY_INCREASE_1", "DAYSEMOTIONALLYCHALLENGING_INCREASE_1"),
  c("JOURNEY_INCREASE_3", "DAYSEMOTIONALLYCHALLENGING_INCREASE_3"),
  c("JOURNEY_INCREASE_6", "DAYSEMOTIONALLYCHALLENGING_INCREASE_6"),
  c("JOURNEY_INCREASE_1", "MANAGESTRESSLEVEL_INCREASE_1"),
  c("JOURNEY_INCREASE_3", "MANAGESTRESSLEVEL_INCREASE_3"),
  c("JOURNEY_INCREASE_6", "MANAGESTRESSLEVEL_INCREASE_6")
)

make_crosstab <- function(row_var, col_var, data = six_month_outcomes) {
  # keep only rows where BOTH variables have a valid (non-missing)
  # response -- USERIDs with NA on either side are dropped entirely
  # rather than shown as a "missing" row/column in the table
  filtered <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[row_var]]), !is.na(.data[[col_var]])) %>%
    select(all_of(c(row_var, col_var)))

  # tbl_cross() requires at least 1 row -- if no USERID has valid
  # responses on both variables at once, skip this pair rather than
  # erroring out
  if (nrow(filtered) == 0) {
    message("Skipping ", row_var, " x ", col_var,
            ": no rows with valid responses on both variables.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  filtered %>%
    tbl_cross(
      row     = all_of(row_var),
      col     = all_of(col_var),
      percent = "row",     # cell percentages (of the table total)
      digits  = c(0, 1),    # 0 decimals for N, 1 decimal for %
      missing = "no"        # safety net: don't add a "missing" row/col
    ) %>%
    bold_labels() %>%
    modify_caption(paste0("**", row_var, " x ", col_var, "**"))
}

crosstab_names <- sapply(crosstab_pairs, paste, collapse = "_vs_")
crosstab_list  <- lapply(crosstab_pairs, function(p) make_crosstab(p[1], p[2]))
names(crosstab_list) <- crosstab_names

# drop any pairs that had no valid overlapping data (see message() output
# above for which ones, if any, were skipped)
crosstab_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), crosstab_list)

# In an R Markdown / Quarto chunk, or at the RStudio console, each table
# renders as a clean formatted table with a caption, row/column labels,
# totals, and "N (pct%)" cells, restricted to valid responses only:
crosstab_list[["JOURNEY_INCREASE_1_vs_END_RISK_1"]]

# to view/render every table in sequence (e.g. in an R Markdown chunk
# with results='asis'):
for (tbl in crosstab_list) print(tbl)

```

``` {r monthly_out_pred_correlations}

Outcomes <- c("STRESSLEVEL", "MANAGEFEELINGSLEVEL", "FEELINGSFREQUENCY", "DAYSEMOTIONALLYCHALLENGING", "MANAGESTRESSLEVEL")

Pred_Out_M <- Monthly_DF[, which(grepl("MONTHLY_SUM", names(Monthly_DF)) | names(Monthly_DF) %in% Outcomes)]

Cors_list <- NULL

for (i in Outcomes) {

ctest_M <- corr.test(Pred_Out_M)
r_value_M <- round(ctest_M$r[, i], 4)
p_value_M <- round(ctest_M$p[, i], 4)
n_value_M <- ctest_M$n[, i]

Monthly_Cors <- data.frame(Correlation = r_value_M, P_Value = p_value_M, N = n_value_M, Outcome = i)

Monthly_Cors$Predictor <- sub(".*\\.", "", rownames(Monthly_Cors))

  Cors_list[[i]] <- Monthly_Cors
  
}

Monthly_Cors_DF <- do.call(rbind, Cors_list)

rownames(Monthly_Cors_DF) <- NULL

```

``` {r daily_out_pred_correlations}
Pred_Out_D <- Daily_DF[, which(grepl("DAILY_SUM", names(Monthly_DF)) | names(Monthly_DF) %in% Outcomes)]

ctest_D <- corr.test(Pred_Out_D)

n_value_D <- ctest_D$n[, i]

Daily_Cors <- data.frame(Correlation = r_value_D, P_Value = p_value_D, N = n_value_D, Outcome = i)

Daily_Cors$Predictor <- sub(".*\\.", "", rownames(Daily_Cors))

  Cors_list[[i]] <- Daily_Cors
  
}

rownames(Daily_Cors_DF) <- NULL
```

``` {r monthly_analyses}
# Standardize (z-score) TOTAL_JOURNEY_USE_M

Monthly_DF_Risk_Modeling <- Monthly_DF_Risk_Modeling %>%
  group_by(USERID) %>%
  mutate(DATE_NUMERIC = as.numeric(EVENTDATE - min(EVENTDATE)) + 1) %>%
  ungroup()

Monthly_DF_Risk_Modeling$TOTAL_JOURNEY_USE_M_z <- scale(Monthly_DF_Risk_Modeling$TOTAL_JOURNEY_USE_M)[,1]





















# Random intercept model: allows each person to have their own baseline stress level

model1 <- lmer(STRESSLEVEL ~ TOTAL_JOURNEY_USE_M_z * DATE_NUMERIC + (1 + TOTAL_JOURNEY_USE_M_z | USERID), data = Monthly_DF_Risk_Modeling)
```

``` {r daily_analyses}
###Risk Signals → Journey Use → Improvement
###Risk Signals → Journey Use → No Improvement
###Risk Signals → Limited/No Journey Use → Worsening Risk



# Install and load the tvem and tidyverse packages

# Example formula where the effect of 'predictor1' varies over 'time'
# grouped by 'subject_id'
tvem_model_D <- tvem(
  formula = FEELINGRATING ~ TOTAL_JOURNEY_USE_D_z,
  data = Daily_DF_Risk_Modeling,
  id = USERID,
  time = DATE_NUMERIC,
  family = gaussian() # Use binomial() for binary outcomes
)

# View the summary of the varying coefficients
summary(tvem_model_D)

# Adjust index/name based on what str() shows you
coef_df_D <- tvem_model_D$grid_fitted_coefficients$TOTAL_JOURNEY_USE_D_z

coef_df_D$time <- tvem_model_D$time_grid

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(coef_df_D, aes(x = time)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = estimate), color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  labs(
    title = "Time-Varying Effect of Total Use on Stress Level",
    x = "Time (days since first observation)",
    y = "Estimated Effect of Total Daily Journey Use on STRESSLEVEL"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)












# Standardize (z-score) TOTAL_JOURNEY_USE_M

Daily_DF_Risk_Modeling$TOTAL_JOURNEY_USE_D_z <- scale(Daily_DF_Risk_Modeling$TOTAL_JOURNEY_USE_D)[,1]

Daily_DF_Risk_Modeling <- Daily_DF_Risk_Modeling %>%
  group_by(USERID) %>%
  mutate(DATE_NUMERIC = as.numeric(EVENTDATE - min(EVENTDATE)) + 1) %>%
  ungroup()

# Random intercept model: allows each person to have their own baseline stress level
model1 <- lmer(FEELINGRATING ~ TOTAL_JOURNEY_USE_D_z + (1 | USERID), data = Daily_DF_Risk_Modeling)

summary(model1)

summary(model2)

model3 <- lmer(FEELINGRATING ~ TOTAL_JOURNEY_USE_D_z * DATE_NUMERIC + (1 | USERID), data = Daily_DF_Risk_Modeling)

summary(model3)

model4 <- lmer(FEELINGRATING ~ TOTAL_JOURNEY_USE_D_z * DATE_NUMERIC + (1 + TOTAL_JOURNEY_USE_D_z | USERID), data = Daily_DF_Risk_Modeling)

summary(model4)
```

``` {r monthly_analyses}
  arrange(USERID, PERIOD) %>%
  group_by(USERID) %>%
  mutate(
    risk_onset_period = ifelse(any(PERIOD_RISK == 1), PERIOD[which(PERIOD_RISK == 1)[1]], NA),

      is.na(risk_onset_period) ~ NA_character_,
      PERIOD < risk_onset_period ~ "before",
      PERIOD >= risk_onset_period ~ "after"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```
